questions.evidence:
BOOKING CARD: Kira and Dan have booked a woodcraft session from one to three. Each has already paid the one-hundred-and-twenty-dollar fee online. They must arrive fifteen minutes early for check-in and each leave a fifty-dollar cash deposit for borrowed tools.

TRAVEL PLAN: Bus C reaches the workshop stop at twelve thirty. The walk to the door takes ten minutes. Bus D arrives at twelve forty, followed by the same walk. The students carry seventy dollars each in cash and do not need to pay another bus fare.

RETURN NOTE: After the session ends, checking tools back in takes ten minutes. The fifty-dollar deposit is then returned if every tool is present. A snack stand beside the return stop sells sandwiches for sixty dollars. The return bus leaves at three thirty-five.

The walk from the workshop door to the return stop takes ten minutes. Buying a sandwich needs five minutes, including waiting and payment. Kira writes a timeline and a separate cash balance so she does not count refundable money as a permanent fee or spend it before it is returned.
questions.prompt: Which bus reaches the door before the check-in deadline?
